create_StandardEnvironment: create a StandardEnvironment instance to get, set, and check environment variables
use_get_rank: use get_rank to read the RANK environment variable as an integer from an Environment
use_get_world_size: use get_world_size to read the WORLD_SIZE environment variable as an integer from an Environment
use_get_local_rank: use get_local_rank to read the LOCAL_RANK environment variable as an integer from an Environment
handle_EnvironmentVariableError: handle EnvironmentVariableError exceptions when environment variables cannot be parsed as integers
